plan.milestone: Every production Session is bounded by a platform token ceiling and an in-Session environment probe, and every stop it raises clears from /todo in at most two clicks, proven by replays of recorded sessions and one validated ledger row per session.

actions.title: Attach the Session probe JSON and its budget to the reconcile receipt as a field, for both failing and passing probes, and verify the checks against a real provider sandbox.
Implement a per-Session input-token ceiling in the production policy that ends the attempt and writes a budget_exhausted stop receipt with cached and uncached tokens recorded separately.
Implement activation so the activated Plan Actions are positioned inside the apply transaction and docs sync retries a transient database lock.
Implement a blocker-kind remedy registry and /todo controls so every platform-raised stop clears in at most two clicks with no typing.

Implement a deterministic probe script that runs as the Session first step and ends the attempt with environment_wall when the Session sandbox cannot write the workspace database, run host validation or produce a preservation receipt.

Implement docs/reports/session-ledger.jsonl with a typed schema, a deterministic validator wired into CI, and backfilled rows for A12, A3, A5 and A6 so every session records cost, review findings, touches and frictions in one compact row.

Implement a fast-rehearsal scenario built from the 2026-10-12 00:40Z Session receipts (no diff, workspace write denied, sandbox test refusals) that must end refused or stopped before a fixed token bound, and make a missing report.json fail loudly.
Record the revised agent roles and a compact session brief template in the governed guidance so Lead sessions start from a generated brief and every role leaves one ledger row.
Stage the matching current_action change in the same governed settlement as a queue reorder and reproduce the live post-activation database lock in a test.

successor.reason: the Plan document names no successor
